title: Exotic Spanish Paella
description: A flavorful and spicy paella dish inspired by Spanish cuisine, featuring exotic spices and seafood.

ingredients.name: Exotic spice blend (cumin, coriander, smoked paprika)
Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use 2-3 cloves for a stronger flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and mussels, and cook until they start to turn pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato, saffron-infused chicken broth, Spanish rice, and exotic spice blend.
Stir well to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
